spec.text: Image 1 is the woman's character model sheet; image 2 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Morning inside a city bus driving through the dense streets of Yonghe, New Taipei: shop fronts with blank signboards, scooters and low apartment blocks pass outside the window. The woman sits at a window seat in the CENTER third of the frame, her face turned toward screen-right, gazing far into the distance with a soft, wistful smile, as if looking at someone very far away. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the woman keeps EXACTLY her model-sheet look: half-up princess-style wavy dark-brown hair with twisted strands at the back, oatmeal knit sweater, sage-green pleated midi skirt, white low sneakers, small tan leather crossbody bag. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
